name: @simbox/agent
description: simbox-agent — in-runner agent that boots agent-device proxy + cloudflared tunnel on a GitHub Actions macOS runner

scripts.build: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --minify src/index.ts --outfile dist/simbox-agent-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --minify src/index.ts --outfile dist/simbox-agent-linux-amd64
